name: Brighton 2022–24
scopeNote: Brighton & Hove Albion under Roberto De Zerbi: first match 2022-10-01 (Liverpool 3-3 Brighton, Premier League; date from search results) to the last match of 2023/24 on 2024-05-19 (Brighton 0-2 Man Utd, final day; date from search results, manutd.com report returned no paragraphs). Excludes Potter's Brighton (to 2022-09-13), Sassuolo/Shakhtar and Hurzeler's 2024/25. Style term used by sources: 'baiting the press' / 'studs-on-the-ball' build-up producing 'artificial transitions'; man-to-man pressing in a nominal 4-2-3-1 (3-4-2-1 used briefly at the start). Most tactical coverage is 2022/23 and Oct 2023-Feb 2024; late-2023/24 (injuries, Europa League exit, decline) is thinly covered.
openQuestions: Exact dates of first and last match rest on search results, not on a mined page.
2023/24 Premier League finish (11th per brief) not verified on a mined page.
Zonal vs man-oriented: Premier League and Analytics FC describe man-to-man pressing; a 2024 thread reportedly describes a zonal switch vs Arsenal (not mined).
Cucurella fee reported as 52.5m (Analytics FC) vs 62.5m elsewhere; Cucurella left before De Zerbi (2022 summer).
